senses.gloss: --a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८५.
--a division of भारतवर्ष. M. ११४. 8; भा. II. १६. 9.
--approached by केशिध्वज to give him a form of expiation. Vi. VI. 6. १५.
--one of the nine divisions of the भारतवर्ष. वा. ४५. ७९, ११९; Vi. II. 3. 6.

(I)--(सवितुः विद्वान्, मारीचि) son of मरीचि and कला, and husband of Diti.
1: भा. III. १४. 7; IV. 1. १३; Br. II. ३७. ४४; III. 2. ३१; 3. ५५; IV. 1. २०; 2. ३३. ४७; M. १४६. १६ & २५; १७१. ३०; १९९. 1, १४, १९; वा. ६३. ४१.
Married twelve (thirteen मत्स्य प्।) daughters of दक्ष, who were ब्रह्मवादिनीस् and लोक-मातस्। Married also पुलोमा and कालका on the advice of ब्रह्मा. Their sons were दानवस् distinguished for warlike qualities. ६०,000 of these were killed by Arjuna while in Heaven to please Indra.
2: भा. VI. 6. 2, २५, ३४-36; M. 4. ५५; 5. १३; 6. 1-2, ४४; वा. ६५. ११५-116, १५७-158.
Aditi was another wife of कश्यप, and was the mother of वामन-Hari. On an appeal from her on behalf of gods exiled from अमरावती, कश्यप taught her the पयोव्रत to please Hari.
3: भा. VIII. १३. 6; १६. 2-२५; १७. २२-3: X. 3. ४२; Br. II. १३. ७९.
Pleased with the anointing of वामन.
4: भा. VIII. २३. २१; M. २४४. ४१; २४५. ८२.
His तेजस्।
5: भा. III. १६. ३५-36; १७. 2.
Pleased with Diti's मदनद्वादशिव्रतम् but did not relish her request for a son to slay Indra but granted it under certain condi- tions.
6: भा. VI. १८. ४४-54: III. chap. १४ (whole); M. 7. ३०-49.
A sage of the Vaivasvata epoch. His descendants.
7: भा. VIII. 8. ३१; १३. 5; M. 9. २७.
Father of Vivasvat.
8: भा. IX. 1. १०; M. ११. 2.
Awarded मध्यदेशा by परशु- राम.
9: भा. IX. १६. २२.
Visited with pupils भीष्म on his death-bed;
१०: Ib. I. 9. 8.
goes round Dhruva.
११: भा. IV. 9. २१; M. १२७. २४;
See दिति, इन्द्र। A ब्रह्मवादिन् and a प्रजापति. A देवऋषि. His sons were नारद and Parvata, as also आदित्यस्, Maruts and Rudras.
१२: Br. II. २७. १०४; ३२. ९८, ११२; ३५. ९२-95: ३८. 3; III. 1. ५३; 4. ३४; 8. 1 and २७; M. १४५. ९२; वा. 1. १३८; 3. 2: ६५. ५३; ८४. २६ and ३१.
An अम्श of ब्रह्मा.
१३: M. ४७. 9; Br. III. 2. १०५; ७१. २३८; वा. 1. १३८; 3. 2; ६५. ११४.
When दक्ष grew angry on account of his daughter कश्यप drank कश्य, a kind of wine;
१४: वा. ६५. ११५-17.
hence his name; hid योग in a cave;
१५: Br. I. 1. ११७; वा. ८३. ८३; Br. III. १९. ५३.
आश्रम of;
१६: वा. ३७. २२.
a sage by ज्ञान;
१७: Ib. ५९. ९०.
place in the विश्वचक्र दान।
१८: M. २८५. 6.
With the sun during the months सह and सहस्य,
१९: Ib. १२७. १७.
a sage of चाक्षुष epoch.
२०: वा. ६२. ६६.
[page१-342+ ३१]

(II)--a sage and contemporary of कृष्ण. In- vited for युधिष्ठिर's राजसूय।
1: भा. X. ७४. 9.
Came to स्यमन्तपञ्- caka to see कृष्ण;
2: Ib. X. ८४. 4.
one of the sages who left for पिण्डारक;
3: Ib. XI. 1. १२.
met by तक्षक on his way to परीक्षित्.
4: Ib. XII. 6. ११.
(III)--a पौराणिक who learnt मूलसम्हिता from the disciple of व्यास. भा. XII. 7. 5 and 7.

(IV)--the sage presiding over the month of सह;
1: भा. XII. ११. ४१.
with the sun in हेमन्तक।
2: वा. ५२. १६.
(V)--(ऋष्यशृण्ग) a sage of the first epoch of सावर्णि Manu. Br. IV. 1. ११.
(VI)--a sage of the स्वारोचिष epoch. M. 9. 8.
(VII)--a sage resorting to शुक्लतीर्थ. M. १९२. १०.

(I)--a सम्हिता-कर्ता: officiated as अध्वर्यु at परशुराम's sacrifice and got the whole earth as fee;
1: Br. II. ३५. ६३ and ६६; III. 8. ८६; ४७. ४७ and ६०; IV. 9. 3.
a मन्त्रकृत् and a ब्रह्मवादिन्.
2: M. १४५. ९८ and १०६; वा. ५९. १०२.
(II)--a sage of सावर्णि epoch; a pravara. M. 9. ३२: १९९. १६.
(III)--a son of वालि, the avatar of the lord. वा. २३. १६०. [page१-375+ ३४]
(IV)--a son of गोकर्ण, the अवतार् of the १६थ् द्वापर। वा. २३. १७३.
(VII)--a son of Suhotra. Vi. IV. 8. 5.
(VIII)--a son of Parvasa. वा. २८. १३.
--author of, a master of अथर्वसम्हित। भा. XII. 7. 4.

--in गया;
1: वा. १०९. १८.
perfomance of श्राद्ध at by भरद्वाज.
2: वा. १११. ४९ and ५८.
--आदित्यस्, Maruts and the Rudras. वा. ६४. 3. [page१-343+ २५]
--articles of, detailed. M. २१७. ७५-81.
--people in ascetic robes. वा. ५८. ६४.
--a son of शुनहोत्र (Sutahotra-वा। प्।) (Suho- tra-वि। प्।). Br. III. ६७. 4; वा. ९२. 3; Vi. IV. 8. 5.
--the kingdom of काश. वा. ९२. 6.
--a kind of grass (सच्चरुम् स्पोन्तनेरुम्) best for श्राद्ध purposes; significance of. वा. ७५. ४१.
--son of काश्य and father of राष्ट्र. भा. IX. १७. 4.

(I) (च्)--a kingdom of मध्यदेश;
1: Br. II. १६. ४१; १८. ५१; III. ७४. २१३ and २६८.
a tribe;
2: M. ११४. ३५; १६३. ६७; २७३. ७३.
a Janapada
3: वा. ४५. ११०; ४७. ४८.
enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus.
4: भा. X. [५० (V) 3].
[page१-373+ ३८]
(III)--the mother of Sarvaga (सर्ववृक-वा। प्।) by भीमसेन. M. ५०. ५४; वा. ९९. २४७; Vi. IV. २०. ४६.

(II)--capital of पौण्ड्रक invaded by कृष्ण; पौण्ड्रक on the S. of the Gomanta hill during the siege by जरासन्ध.
1: भा. X. ६६. [१२], १०; ५२. ११ [9].
The अभिचार Agni sent by सुदक्षिण returned and killed सुदक्षिण himself, while विष्णु's Cakra burnt down the whole city.
2: Ib. X. ६६. ३०-42; ३७. १९.
Its king went to स्यमन्तपञ्- caka for solar eclipse having heard that कृष्ण was there.
3: Ib. X. ८२. २५.
When the kingdom had no rains, its king gave his daughter गान्दिनी to श्वफल्क, and this resulted in plenty of showers.
4: Ib. X. ५७. ३२. Br. III. ७१. १०४.
Likened to भागवत पुराण in its importance.
5: भा. XII. १३. १७.
Sages of, visited द्वारका.
6: Ib. X. ९०. २८ [3].
Residence of कामाक्षी
7: Br. IV. ३७. १५; ४०. १५ and ८०, ९१.
the capital of कुशध्वज;
8: वा. ८१. १८; ९९. ४०२.
in the brows of the Veda.
9: Ib. १०४. ७५.
--R. from शुक्तिमन्त. M. ११४. ३२.
--a son of काश्य. Br. III. ६७. 7.

--the kingdom of, got rain by the presence of श्वफल्क; daughter of (गान्दिनी) married to श्वफल्क;
1: वा. ९६. १०३-5; Vi. IV. १३. ११६.
a daughter Jayanti married to वृषभ.
2: M. ४५. २६.
--a दानव king. Br. IV. २९. १२२.

--see (काशिराज): king of कासि who went to aid पौण्ड्रक against कृष्ण and who was so struck that his head shot into the city; his son together with the priest prayed to शिव to avenge his father's murder; शिव granted the boon and sent a female created from fire to destroy कृष्ण whose discus was more than a metal; the dead ran to काशि followed by the discus which burnt the whole city. Vi. V. ३४. १४-43.
--the son of काश; king of कासी; father of राष्ट्र. Vi. IV. 8. 7.
--a ruling dynasty of २४ rulers. M. २७२. १५. [page१-374+ २९]
--father of सुपार्श्व. वा. ९६. २५२.

--became the possession of व्रात्यस् and Mlecchas;
1: भा. XII. 1. ३९; Vi. IV. २४. ६९.
a kingdom of the West watered by the Sindhu.
2: Br. II. १६. ५१. १८. ४७; III. ७४. २१३.
A तीर्थम् sacred to मेधा.
3: M. १३. ४७.
(I)--a son of Suhotra, and father of काशी. भा. IX. १७. 3-4.
(II)--a son of सेनाजित्. भा. IX. २१. २३; Vi. IV. १९. ३६.
(III)--a क्षत्रिय who became a द्विज। Br. III. ६६. ८७.
--a daughter of सुपार्श्व and wife of साम्ब; had five sons. M. ४७. २४.
--a daughter of काश्य, and wife of आहुक; mother of Devaka and Ugrasena. M. ४४. ७०-1.

--the lines of kings commencing with Sannuhotra काश, ruled at काशी. Six of them were ब्रह्मवादिन्स्। Among them were ब्राह्मणस् and क्ष- triyas whose sons were righteous, powerful and strong. Br. II. ३२. ११२; III. ६७. ७९; वा. ९२. ७४.
--(कालसर्पि): fit for श्राद्ध। वा. ७७. ८७. [page१-376+ ३०]
--आर्षेय pravara of the भार्गवस्. M. १९५. ३७.

--one of the sages who heard the first part (sarga) of the पुराण asked सूत to speak on प्रतिसन्धि;
1: वा. 7. 1.
a gotrakara.
2: M. १९९. 9.
--pseudo-ascetics. Br. III. १५. ६२; वा. ७९. ९०.

--a measurement of length and capacity; ययाति versed in;
1: M. ३४. 9; १४२. 4.
the intervening distance between two काष्ठस् and the distance between काष्ठ and लेख, north to south; both the outer and inner circumference in दक्षिणायन and उत्तरायण
2: वा. 1. ९३; ५०. १२७, १३२ and १३३.
thirty form a कल।
3: वा. ३०. १३; Vi. I. 3. 8; II. 8. ५९; VI. 3. 6.
Time equal to १५ निमेषस्।
4: Br. II. 7. १९; १३. १६; वा. ५०. १६९; ५७. 6; ७०. १५; ९३. ७२; १००. २१४; Vi. I. 3. 8.
--one of the कश्यप's wives, and mother of quadrupeds with cloven hoofs; a mother goddess. भा. VI. 6. २५ and २९; Br. III. 3. ५६; IV. ३२. १४.
--कश्यप gotrakaras. M. १९९. 9.
--a pupil of बाष्कलि. भा. XII. 6. ५९. [page१-377+ ३७]
